title: Office Kernel
description: Immutable per-run packet header. Opens every planner, executor, verifier, and reviewer packet verbatim. Narrowing a field is allowed; widening it is not.

core_version.description: office-core protocol version this packet was built against.

invocation_id.description: Stable id for this office run. Recorded at explicit dispatch, never inferred from a transcript.

role.description: The role this packet is built for. Determines which spokes are selected.

worker_kind.description: Optional Executor-owned worker specialization. A tester keeps role=executor and never becomes a standing gate.

path.description: Path to the approved plan file.

version.description: Plan revision, bumped on any post-approval amendment.

approved.description: Explicit user approval of this plan version. false blocks all dispatch.

worktree_id.description: Identity of the tree, used to enforce one independent writer per tree and coordinate the Tester exception.

work_items.description: Only the numbered plan items in scope for this packet.

strategy.description: Office-specific routing tag, e.g. SONNET, PRO, INLINE, PLANNER-HELD.

protected_paths.description: Pre-existing dirty or off-limits paths. Never modified, never reverted.

ceiling.description: The verbatim ceiling block from the plan's Global Constraints. Restated unchanged in every downstream brief.

permitted_side_effects.description: Exact actions authorized for this packet. Anything absent is forbidden.

forbidden.description: Explicit exclusions. An unstated exclusion is one a helpful agent will finish for you.

mechanisms.description: Enforcement behind the prose: tool allowlist, deny hook, isolated worktree, absent credentials, sandbox.

pinned_interfaces.description: Real signatures read from source. Required by agy-office, optional elsewhere.

source.description: file:line the signature was read from.

validation.description: The exact validation commands that constitute the gate.

capability_manifest_path.description: Path to the selected-skills manifest. Replaces any catalog dump.
